name: Shackleton Rim
description: Ultra-high prominence crater rim receiving up to 86-90% annual illumination with direct DTE line-of-sight.

name: Connecting Ridge
description: Strategic narrow ridge linking Shackleton with de Gerlache. Excellent solar window with periodic libration-driven Earth dips.

name: Malapert Massif
description: Towering 5,000m lunar mountain providing exceptional continuous Earth visibility and expansive solar horizons.

name: Haworth Crater Rim
description: Proximity to high-concentration volatile cold traps, bounded by steep undulating crater rim elevations.

name: Nobile Rim 1
description: Accessible rolling terrain with varied thermal conditions and stable direct-to-Earth communication link.
